source_notes: Authoritative base: idictation.cn (爱听写 / 神奇题库) current 2026 May-August Part 1 season bank, scraped 2026-06-14.
Thin idictation topics (fewer than 8 questions) were topped up with genuinely distinct questions from the IELTSBro 0604 PDF using Jaccard fuzzy dedup (>=0.55 dropped) to avoid paraphrase bloat.
No AI-generated questions were added; every question traces to idictation or the 0604 PDF.
Stale topics not present in the current idictation season were moved to data/ielts/archive/old_topics.json.
